Fixed effects (within) estimator for panel data

Source: R/econometrics.R
panel_within.Rd

Least squares after subtracting the unit means (and, for two way effects, after also projecting out time dummies), as plm(model = "within"). Equal to least squares with unit (and time) dummies, without building them. A three part formula y ~ x | z gives the within (fixed effects) instrumental variable estimator: two stage least squares on the demeaned data, as plm(y ~ x | z, model = "within").

Usage

panel_within(
  formula,
  data,
  id,
  time = NULL,
  effect = c("individual", "twoways")
)

Arguments

formula

A formula y ~ x1 + x2 without an intercept term (absorbed by the unit effects), or y ~ regressors | instruments for instrumental variables.

data

A data frame.

id, time

Names of the unit and time variables in data.

effect

"individual" or "twoways".

Value

An object of class regcomp_lm.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:50, each = 5), t = rep(1:5, 50), x = rnorm(250))
a <- rnorm(50); d$x <- d$x + a[d$id]; d$y <- 1 + 0.5 * d$x + a[d$id] + rnorm(250)
panel_within(y ~ x, data = d, id = "id")
#> <regcomp_lm> within estimator (individual effects), n = 250, residual df = 199
#>   estimate std_error      t p_value
#> x   0.5026    0.0773 6.5003       0
